entry_state: Bank capital requires instrument eligibility, deductions and dated rules beyond accounting equity. The restricted prudential example distinguishes allowance-cap base120 from final risk-weighted assets119.1; adequate capital ratios coexist with an unpaid deposit9. Average-assets evidence is separately needed for leverage. Expected loss retains conditional exposure/severity dependence. Classification requires business-model and contractual-flow findings; amortised cost, debt FVOCI and FVTPL can end at cash/equity198 with different interim income, while equity FVOCI does not recycle. Section11.3.2 has introduced modified-time-value comparison and continues with nonrecourse terms after258.
exit_state: Classification precedes measurement and missing evidence does not prove an actual holder failed its assessment. Commitment draw conditions out no-draw, preserves original credit history and changes provision2 into funded allowance4. The separate ordinary loan ends with loss39.5 and negative equity; credit impairment and write-off findings differ. POCI price50 already incorporates initial loss: revised expected88 yields net80 and signed allowance−25; interest follows net80, and eventual receipt70 leaves contractual shortfall51 without proving legal discharge. The POCI subsection continues after264.

findings.observation: Classification, event order and default-horizon distinctions precede the dated calculations. Unsupported weights cannot silently become a probability-weighted allowance.
The draw example derives conditional ECL4, shows two distinct ways to obtain the wrong amount2, and reconciles provision transfer and alternative settlement paths.

Non-POCI and POCI paths retain different initial loss and interest bases. The signed allowance and net-interest displays are introduced with definitions and worked consequences; future legal discharge remains unassessed.
